## 09:30 · 科技速递 · Tech

- 时间 Time: 2026-10-15 09:30 (UTC+8)
- 窗口 Window: 2026-10-14 21:30 – 2026-10-15 09:35（北京时间）
- 标签 Tags: Agents, Dev Tools, Open Source, Chinese Community

### 新产品 / 开源
1. **OpenCode 2.0**: a major refactor of the open-source coding agent. The server now stays resident by default as a background process, and the TUI, web version and desktop version all connect to the same process; the API was torn down and rewritten, agents can call their own API, e.g. automatically moving a session into a git worktree when starting a new task, and `@opencode/client` scripts can auto-discover the local server. [Release notes](https://anoma.ly/notes/opencode-2-0/) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50094994) (some like that it's one of the few open-source agents usable outside a TUI; others grumble the install script is absurdly slow because of progress-bar rendering, and another warns that after the upgrade tool calls all go through the background process, so sandboxes that used to wrap around the TUI will silently stop working)
> **[zh]** **OpenCode 2.0**：开源编程 Agent 的大版本重构。服务端现在默认作为一个后台进程常驻，TUI、网页版和桌面版都连同一个进程；API 推倒重写，Agent 还能调用自己的 API，比如开新任务时自动把会话挪进 git worktree，`@opencode/client` 脚本也能自动发现本地服务。[发布说明](https://anoma.ly/notes/opencode-2-0/) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50094994)（有人喜欢它是少数能脱离 TUI 用的开源 Agent；也有人吐槽安装脚本因进度条渲染慢得离谱，还有人提醒升级后工具调用都走后台进程，原来包在 TUI 外面的沙箱会悄悄失效）
2. **Petal**: a free open-source pair-programming tool from the original CoScreen team, with low-latency multi-window sharing and remote control, where each shared window is a draggable native window on the other person's desktop; currently supports macOS and Windows, with Linux in the works. [Website](https://petal.live/) ｜ [GitHub](https://github.com/kiruna-labs/petal) ｜ [Show HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50092470) (a Screenhero co-founder came by to congratulate, and commenters compare it with Tuple and ask how LiveKit's latency is tuned)
> **[zh]** **Petal**：CoScreen 原班人马做的免费开源结对编程工具，低延迟多窗口共享和远程控制，每个共享窗口在对方桌面上都是一个能拖动的原生窗口；目前支持 macOS 和 Windows，Linux 在做。[官网](https://petal.live/) ｜ [GitHub](https://github.com/kiruna-labs/petal) ｜ [Show HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50092470)（Screenhero 联合创始人亲自来道贺，评论里也有人拿它和 Tuple 比，并问 LiveKit 的延迟调得怎么样）
3. **Graphicle**: a code-graph plus memory tool written in Rust that gives MCP clients like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor context with file and line references, running fully locally with no API key and no telemetry. [GitHub](https://github.com/graphicle-ai/graphicle) ｜ [Show HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50088713) (one says in his evals such memory systems did worse than just giving ripgrep; another thinks binding memory to specific functions and invalidating it when the code changes is the real highlight)
> **[zh]** **Graphicle**：用 Rust 写的代码图谱加记忆工具，给 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 MCP 客户端提供带文件和行号引用的上下文，全本地运行，不需要 API key，也没有遥测。[GitHub](https://github.com/graphicle-ai/graphicle) ｜ [Show HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50088713)（有人说自己的评测里这类记忆系统还不如直接给 ripgrep；也有人认为把记忆绑定到具体函数上、代码改了就让记忆失效，才是它真正的亮点）
4. **neckbeard**: a coding-agent plugin aimed at agents going wild when writing infrastructure. Humans maintain a set of CI-tested OpenTofu modules; after reading the repo and asking questions the code can't answer, the agent maps the application onto these modules and attaches a monthly bill estimate. [GitHub](https://github.com/bealesh/neckbeard) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50091794) (someone questions whether just having the agent write OpenTofu plus Ansible is enough, and another says a $25 Hetzner box is plenty)
> **[zh]** **neckbeard**：一个编程 Agent 插件，专门对付 Agent 写基础设施时胡来。由人维护一套经过 CI 测试的 OpenTofu 模块，Agent 读完仓库、问清代码回答不了的问题后，把应用映射到这些模块上，还附上每月账单估算。[GitHub](https://github.com/bealesh/neckbeard) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50091794)（有人质疑直接让 Agent 写 OpenTofu 加 Ansible 就行，也有人说一台 25 美元的 Hetzner 足够了）
5. **iFixAi** (GitHub Trending, up 2,100+ stars today): a tool for independently auditing AI agents that either a human or the agent itself can run, claiming to answer "is this agent doing what it should?" within two minutes, with a Chinese README. [GitHub](https://github.com/ifixai-ai/iFixAi)
> **[zh]** **iFixAi**（GitHub Trending，今天涨了 2100 多星）：独立审计 AI Agent 的工具，人或 Agent 自己都能跑，号称两分钟内回答"这个 Agent 有没有在做它该做的事"，有中文 README。

1. **Linus Torvalds sends his first LLM-assisted patches**: 10 patches put folio data reads inside an RCU-protected section so the fast path no longer takes a reference count, an order of magnitude faster in a read()-heavy benchmark; but review has already found a race condition, so it needs another revision. [LWN](https://lwn.net/Articles/1100449/) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50090842) (someone is surprised he used closed-source Claude rather than an open model, others use it to discuss AI assistance on critical infrastructure, and some find LLM-written commit messages too wordy)
> **[zh]** **Linus Torvalds 发出第一组 LLM 辅助的补丁**：10 个补丁把 folio 的数据读取也放进 RCU 保护区，快路径不用再拿引用计数，在大量 `read()` 的基准测试里快了一个数量级；不过评审已经发现一个竞态条件，还要再改。[LWN](https://lwn.net/Articles/1100449/) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50090842)（评论里有人惊讶他用的是闭源的 Claude 而不是开源模型，有人借此讨论关键基础设施用 AI 辅助的问题，也有人嫌 LLM 写的 commit message 太啰嗦）

This is tonight's hottest HN post. [CSO Online](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4234854/ai-agents-arent-going-rogue-frontier-labs-are-skipping-security-basics.html) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50091788) (a top comment says both can be true at once: models really do act out of bounds, and labs' security practice really is amateurish; another says the scary part isn't agents escaping but that they want to)
> **[zh]** **专家：所谓"AI 失控黑客事件"，主要是实验室没做好隔离和监控**：CSO Online 采访安全专家，认为前沿实验室跳过了安全基本功。这是今晚 HN 第一热帖。[CSO Online](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4234854/ai-agents-arent-going-rogue-frontier-labs-are-skipping-security-basics.html) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50091788)（高赞评论说两者可以同时成立：模型确实在做出格的事，实验室的安全实践也确实业余；还有人说真正可怕的不是 Agent 跑出来，而是它们想跑）

### 新产品 / 开源
1. **LFM2.5-24B-A2B** (Liquid AI): a reasoning MoE with 24B total parameters and only 2B active per token, built for local agents, with open weights (including a Base version) and context extended from 32K to 128K; the company says 184 tokens/s on an M5 Max and matches or beats Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on five agent/tool-calling benchmarks. Now also on HF Trending. [Official blog](https://www.liquid.ai/blog/lfm2-5-24b-a2b) ｜ [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50097369) (hands-on opinions differ: one had it write a small feature in the ghostty codebase and it went in circles over compile errors while Qwen 3.8, though slow, finished; another says knowledge tasks are clearly worse than Qwen 35B but the speed is great)
> **[zh]** **LFM2.5-24B-A2B**（Liquid AI）：24B 总参数、每 token 只激活 2B 的推理 MoE，专做本地 Agent，权重开放（含 Base 版），上下文从 32K 扩到 128K；官方称在 M5 Max 上 184 tokens/s，五项 Agent/工具调用基准追平或超过 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B。现在也在 HF Trending 上。[官方博客](https://www.liquid.ai/blog/lfm2-5-24b-a2b) ｜ [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50097369)（实测评价分歧：有人在 ghostty 代码库里让它写个小功能，结果在编译错误里来回打转，Qwen 3.8 虽慢却做完了；也有人说知识类明显不如 Qwen 35B，但速度很香）
2. **XERJ** (GitHub Trending, +725 stars today): a local search index written in Rust that indexes code, docs, logs and PDFs with one command, then plugs into Claude Code / Cursor via MCP and skill so the agent stops grepping through files one by one; it also pushes "reference programming": first pull down and index similar open-source repos, see how others solved the same kind of problem, then start. The project claims 2.7x fewer output tokens in one controlled experiment with the same number of problems solved, and is compatible with Elasticsearch clients. [GitHub](https://github.com/xerj-org/xerj)
> **[zh]** **XERJ**（GitHub Trending，今天 +725 星）：Rust 写的本地搜索索引，一条命令把代码、文档、日志、PDF 建索引，再通过 MCP 和 skill 接进 Claude Code / Cursor，让 Agent 不再一个个 grep 读文件；还主打「参考编程」，先拉下相近的开源仓库建索引，看别人怎么解决同类问题再动手。项目自称在一次对照实验里输出 token 少了 2.7 倍，解题数不变，兼容 Elasticsearch 客户端。
3. **caveman** (GitHub Trending, +398 stars today): a skill plus proxy that makes coding agents say less, like a caveman: talk less, read less, keep code unchanged. The project's numbers are 33% fewer input tokens over a whole session, and with Auto mode 54% lower cost at the same score. Worth a look if you want to cut Claude Code costs. [GitHub](https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman)
> **[zh]** **caveman**（GitHub Trending，今天 +398 星）：让编程 Agent 像原始人一样少废话的 skill 加代理，少说少读、代码保持原样。项目给的数据是整段会话输入 token 少 33%，配合 Auto 模式成本降 54%、得分不变。想压 Claude Code 成本的可以看看。
4. **Flipflop** (Show HN): a persistent encrypted tunnel between devices built on Iroh; after pairing once, you can send files, links and text at any time over Bluetooth, LAN or the internet, written in Rust + Slint, with Linux / macOS / Windows / Android versions. [GitHub](https://github.com/andunieee/flipflop) ｜ [Show HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50099136) (in comments someone asks how it differs from Tailscale Taildrop, and another says his files are all in Syncthing already)
> **[zh]** **Flipflop**（Show HN）：基于 Iroh 的设备间常驻加密隧道，配对一次之后随时互传文件、链接和文本，蓝牙、局域网、公网都能走，Rust + Slint 写，有 Linux / macOS / Windows / Android 版。[GitHub](https://github.com/andunieee/flipflop) ｜ [Show HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50099136)（评论里有人问和 Tailscale Taildrop 有什么不同，也有人说自己的文件早都放进 Syncthing 了）
5. **Ito** (Show HN): a library for writing declarative terminal UIs in Lua, with Rust underneath; the authors are two Neovim enthusiasts who found JS-written agent harnesses hard to tinker with, so they built it; the web playground includes an `ito.md` guide you can hand straight to an LLM. [Playground](https://uji.sh/ito/) ｜ [Show HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50096300) (someone suggests using Lua's parenthesis-free call syntax more so it reads more like Lua)
> **[zh]** **Ito**（Show HN）：用 Lua 写声明式终端 UI 的库，底层是 Rust，作者是两个 Neovim 爱好者，嫌 JS 写的 Agent harness 不好折腾才做了它；网页 playground 里带一份可以直接丢给 LLM 的 `ito.md` 指南。[Playground](https://uji.sh/ito/) ｜ [Show HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50096300)（有人建议多用 Lua 的免括号调用语法，写出来会更像 Lua）

### 科技新闻
1. **Citizen Lab exposes AdFection: zero-click spyware delivered through online ads**: the first technical evidence that commercial spyware can be distributed via online advertising; an Israeli ad company steered target users to spyware servers, and dozens of Al Jazeera devices were compromised as a result. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/15/citizen-lab-says-governments-are-abusing-online-ads-to-hack-people-with-zero-click-spyware/) ｜ [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/oct/15/israeli-firm-digital-ads-enabling-installation-of-zero-click-spyware-researchers-say) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50103000) (what people care about most is whether ad blockers stop it, and someone says ordinary people finally have a reason to hate ads)
> **[zh]** **Citizen Lab 曝光 AdFection：靠网络广告投放的零点击间谍软件**：首次拿出技术证据，证明商业间谍软件可以通过在线广告分发，一家以色列广告公司把目标用户导向间谍软件服务器，半岛电视台有几十台设备因此被入侵。[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/15/citizen-lab-says-governments-are-abusing-online-ads-to-hack-people-with-zero-click-spyware/) ｜ [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/oct/15/israeli-firm-digital-ads-enabling-installation-of-zero-click-spyware-researchers-say) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50103000)（大家最关心广告拦截器能不能挡住，也有人说这下普通人终于有理由讨厌广告了）
2. **The FTC issues roughly 50-page investigative demands to OpenAI and Anthropic**: per Axios, the investigation focuses on safety incidents, safeguards and consumer protection; separately, 8 states just sued OpenAI, saying ChatGPT is unsafe for children and misleads users. [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261015/p20#a261015p20) ｜ [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1011500/openai-state-lawsuits-chatgpt-safety)
> **[zh]** **FTC 向 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 发出约 50 页的调查令**：据 Axios，调查聚焦安全事故、防护措施和消费者保护；另外，8 个州也刚起诉了 OpenAI，称 ChatGPT 对儿童不安全、误导用户。
3. **Bank of America hired 1,000 more contractors to fix AI-discovered vulnerabilities**: per CNBC, BofA hired 1,000 contractors in Q2 to work with 3,000 internal staff patching vulnerabilities in its own and vendor software found by models like Mythos. The speed at which AI finds bugs is already forcing customers to expand headcount. [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261015/p27#a261015p27)
> **[zh]** **美国银行为修 AI 挖出的漏洞多招了 1000 名外包**：据 CNBC，BofA 二季度招了 1000 名外包，配合 3000 名内部员工修补 Mythos 这类模型挖出来的自有和供应商软件漏洞。AI 找漏洞的速度已经倒逼甲方扩编了。
4. **Ubuntu 26.10 released**: the default command-line tools have all moved to the Rust uutils, with the last holdouts `cp`, `mv` and `rm` switched too; also GNOME 51, Linux 7.3 (first images based on rc6), OpenSSL 4 with ECH, the first RISC-V desktop image, and a preview of Myna, a fully local dictation tool. > **[en]** **V2EX "Share Creations": two agent-engineering projects**: OpenNavo is an open-source macOS Homebrew GUI store (Tauri 2 + Vue 3 + Rust, Go backend), where the author hands as much daily development and maintenance as possible to agents and even built a dedicated MCP backend interface for them; EverAgent is a persistent agent harness that writes conversations, model turns, tool calls and checkpoints to SQLite first, so it can resume from a checkpoint if the process crashes.
